used Fe2 STD Iron(II)Chloride tetrahydrate, Ferrous Ammonium Sulfate Hexahydrate (NH4)2Fe(SO4)2, and Iron(III)Chloride.

used 2ml STD 0.3ml hydroxylamine Hydrochloride waited 10 min before pipetting( actual time to abs1 ~30 min), then 60min( actual time to abs1 ~90 min)

for FeCl2+ 2M HCl, 0.3ml Hydrochloride Acid waited 10 min before pipetting( actual time to abs1 ~30 min)

for FeCl2 No RA, 2M HCl was add instead of hydroxylamine Hydrochloride

```{r Set Up Code - constants and QAQC cutoffs, include=FALSE}

#Flag cutoffs
  r2_cutoff = 0.985            #this is the level below which we want to rerun or consider a curve 
  cv_flag_stds = 10           #this is the maximum cv allowed for standards
  p_value_chkstds = 0.05      #the p-value for the t-test between check  and top std must be greater than this
  cv_flag_sample = 10         #this is the maximum cv allowed for samples
  dups_perc_diff = 15.5       #this is the maximum percent difference allowed between duplicates
  high_recovery_cutoff = 120  #this is the maximum percent recovery allowed in spiked samples
  low_recovery_cutoff = 80    #this is the minimum percent recovery allowed in spiked samples

# Chk Standard concentrations - Update if running different standard curve:
# standard units are in uM


#Spike concentration calc
  #spike for these samples was 55 uL of the 60uM standard
  Con1 <- 1000000               #conversion factor value for spike volumes (uL -> L)
  spk_std <- 60                # uM Fe2- standard used
  spkvol <- 55                  # uL volume of spike added
  spk_Conc <- spk_std*(spkvol/Con1)   # this would be in umoles of FE in the spk
  sample_vol <- 160             # the sample volume without the spike is 160 uL

#Top standard Concentration- Update if running different standard curve: 
Top_STD_Fe2_low = 60
Top_STD_Fe3_low = 60

Top_STD_Fe2_high = 500
Top_STD_Fe3_high = 100
Top_STD_Fe2_Abs2_high=100

```
#Read in plates
```{r}
#read in the csv files
stds<-read_plates(
  files = c(HAHCl_10min,HAHCl_60min) ,#list of all file paths
  plate_names = c("10min_HAHCl","60min_HAHCl") ,  #list of plate names          
  well_ids_column = "Wells",    # name to give column of well IDs (optional)
  sep = ","                     # separator used in the csv file (optional)
) 
head(stds)

stds<- stds %>% mutate(Plate = case_when(
  IDs %like% "Fe[(]III[)][+]RA" ~ paste("Fe(III)",Plate),
  IDs %like% "FeCl2[+]RA" ~ paste("FeCl2",Plate),
  IDs %like% "FeNH4SO4" ~ paste("FeNH4SO4",Plate),
  IDs %like% "FeCl2[+]2M HCl" ~ paste("FeCl2+ 2M HCl",Plate),
  IDs %like% "2MHCl instead RA" ~ paste("FeCl2","No RA"),
  .default = Plate
))
                         
```
```{r Remove high cv stds,echo=FALSE,fig.keep='none',include=FALSE}
stds_all<- stds[!is.na(stds$IDs),]

#Calculate CVs and add flags
FE_STD_cv <- stds_all %>% group_by(Plate, IDs) %>%
  mutate(Abs1_sd=sd(Abs1), Abs1_cv = cv(Abs1), 
         Abs1_cv_flag = ifelse(Abs1_cv >= cv_flag_stds, "High CV", "Good CV"),
         Abs2_sd=sd(Abs2), Abs2_cv = cv(Abs2), 
         Abs2_cv_flag = ifelse(Abs2_cv >= cv_flag_stds, "High CV", "Good CV")) %>% ungroup()

#calculate new cv getting best cv from points if cv was high
FE_STD_cv_new <- FE_STD_cv %>% group_by(Plate, IDs) %>%
  mutate(Abs1_CV_New = map_dbl(row_number(), ~cv(Abs1[-.x])), #Calculate CVs without 1 point
    Abs1_Removed = ifelse(             #Choose Lowest CV if CV is high
    Abs1_cv_flag == "High CV",
    ifelse(
      Abs1_CV_New == min(Abs1_CV_New),
      "RMVD",
      "KEPT"), "Good CV"),
    Abs1_cv2 = ifelse(Abs1_cv_flag == "High CV", min(Abs1_CV_New), Abs1_cv),
    Abs1_rm = ifelse(Abs1_Removed == "RMVD", NA, Abs1)) %>% 
    mutate(Abs2_CV_New = map_dbl(row_number(), ~cv(Abs2[-.x])),  #Calculate CVs without 1 point
    Abs2_Removed = ifelse(             #Choose Lowest CV if CV is high
      Abs2_cv_flag == "High CV",
      ifelse(
        Abs2_CV_New == min(Abs2_CV_New),
        "RMVD",
        "KEPT"), "Good CV"),
    Abs2_cv2 = ifelse(Abs2_cv_flag == "High CV", min(Abs2_CV_New), Abs2_cv),
    Abs2_rm = ifelse(Abs2_Removed == "RMVD", NA, Abs2)) %>%
  mutate(Abs1_Mean = mean(Abs1_rm, na.rm = TRUE),
         Abs1_sd2 = sd(Abs1_rm, na.rm = TRUE),
         Abs2_Mean = mean(Abs2_rm, na.rm = TRUE),
         Abs2_sd2 = sd(Abs2_rm, na.rm = TRUE)
         
  ) %>%
  mutate(Abs1_cv_flag2 = ifelse(Abs1_cv2 >= cv_flag_stds, "High CV", "Good CV"), 
         Abs2_cv_flag2 = ifelse(Abs2_cv2 >= cv_flag_stds, "High CV", "Good CV")) %>% ungroup()

#organize data
FE_STD_CV_fin <- FE_STD_cv_new %>% 
  dplyr::select(Plate, Wells, Abs1, Abs1_Removed, Abs2, Abs2_Removed, IDs, Conc_uM,
                Abs1_Mean, Abs1_sd2, Abs1_cv2, Abs1_cv_flag2,
                Abs2_Mean, Abs2_sd2, Abs2_cv2, Abs2_cv_flag2) %>% 
  mutate(Abs1_sd = Abs1_sd2 ,Abs1_cv_flag = Abs1_cv_flag2, Abs1_cv = Abs1_cv2,
         Abs2_sd = Abs2_sd2 ,Abs2_cv_flag = Abs2_cv_flag2, Abs2_cv = Abs2_cv2) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Plate, Wells, IDs, Conc_uM,  Abs1, Abs1_Removed, Abs2, Abs2_Removed,
                Abs1_Mean, Abs1_sd2, Abs1_cv, 
                Abs2_Mean, Abs2_sd2, Abs2_cv, Abs1_cv_flag, Abs2_cv_flag)%>% mutate(Abs_diff = Abs2 - Abs1) %>% group_by(Plate, IDs) %>% mutate(diff_Mean= mean(Abs_diff), diff_cv = cv(Abs_diff)) %>% ungroup()

```

```{r subset Stds,include=FALSE}

#subset by FE_2
FE_2_stds_Abs1 <- FE_STD_CV_fin %>%  
  filter(str_detect(FE_STD_CV_fin$IDs, "Fe[(]II[)]"), !Abs1_Removed == "RMVD") 
FE_2_stds_Abs2 <- FE_STD_CV_fin %>%  
  filter(str_detect(FE_STD_CV_fin$IDs, "Fe[(]II[)]"), !(Conc_uM > Top_STD_Fe2_Abs2_high),!Abs2_Removed == "RMVD")%>% mutate(Curve = "FE_2_abs2")
#subset by FE_3
FE_3_stds_Abs1 <- FE_STD_CV_fin %>%  
  filter(str_detect(FE_STD_CV_fin$IDs, "Fe[(]III[)]"), !Abs1_Removed == "RMVD")%>% mutate(Curve = "FE_3_abs1")
FE_3_stds_Abs2 <- FE_STD_CV_fin %>%  
  filter(str_detect(FE_STD_CV_fin$IDs, "Fe[(]III[)]"), !(Conc_uM > Top_STD_Fe3_high), !Abs2_Removed == "RMVD") 

#subset Fe3 STD with in their linear range
FE_3_stds_high <- FE_3_stds_Abs2 %>% mutate(Curve = "FE_Tot_high")

#subset Fe2 abs2 to 100um 
FE_2_stds_high <-FE_2_stds_Abs1 %>% mutate(Curve = "FE_2_high")
FE_2_stds_diff<-FE_2_stds_Abs2 %>% filter(!Abs1_Removed == "RMVD") %>% mutate(Curve = "FE_2_diff")

#Subset the low standard curve from all 
FE_2_stds_low <- FE_2_stds_Abs1  %>% filter(!Conc_uM > Top_STD_Fe2_low) %>% mutate(Curve = "FE_2_low")
FE_3_stds_low <- FE_3_stds_Abs2 %>% filter(!Conc_uM > Top_STD_Fe3_low) %>% mutate(Curve = "FE_Tot_low")

#combine into one dataframe
STDs<-list(FE_2_stds_high, FE_2_stds_low, FE_2_stds_Abs2 ,FE_2_stds_diff, FE_3_stds_Abs1, FE_3_stds_high, FE_3_stds_low)
STDs_Curves<- reduce(STDs, full_join)

```


```{r calculte slope and intercept, include=FALSE}
split_data <- STDs_Curves %>% #Split Data by Plate
  group_by(Plate, Curve) %>%
  group_split()

#run regression and get coefficients by Run
Slope_FE_raw_list <- map(split_data, ~ .x %>% mutate( 
    R2 =  case_when(
        Curve == "FE_2_diff"  ~ summary(lm(Abs_diff ~ Conc_uM, data = .))$adj.r.squared,
        Curve == "FE_2_high"|Curve == "FE_2_low"|Curve == "FE_3_abs1"  ~ summary(lm(Abs1 ~ Conc_uM, data = .))$adj.r.squared,
        Curve %like% "FE_Tot"|Curve == "FE_2_abs2"  ~ summary(lm(Abs2 ~ Conc_uM, data = .))$adj.r.squared), 
    Slope = case_when(
        Curve == "FE_2_diff"  ~ coef(lm(Abs_diff ~ Conc_uM, data = .))[2],
        Curve == "FE_2_high"|Curve == "FE_2_low"|Curve == "FE_3_abs1"  ~ coef(lm(Abs1 ~ Conc_uM, data = .))[2],
        Curve %like% "FE_Tot"|Curve == "FE_2_abs2"  ~ coef(lm(Abs2 ~ Conc_uM, data = .))[2]),
    Intercept = case_when(
        Curve == "FE_2_diff"  ~ coef(lm(Abs_diff ~ Conc_uM, data = .))[1],
        Curve == "FE_2_high"|Curve == "FE_2_low"|Curve == "FE_3_abs1"  ~ coef(lm(Abs1 ~ Conc_uM, data = .))[1],
        Curve %like% "FE_Tot"|Curve == "FE_2_abs2"  ~ coef(lm(Abs2 ~ Conc_uM, data = .))[1]
                                                      )))

Slope_FE_raw <- bind_rows(Slope_FE_raw_list)%>% mutate(R2_Flag = ifelse(R2 >= r2_cutoff, "R2_Good", "R2_Bad"))

#check R2 and flag
Slope_FE_Std_Crvs <- Slope_FE_raw %>% dplyr::select(Plate, Curve, R2, Slope, Intercept) %>% distinct() 

#join standard curve CVs and regression values
R2_Check_Raw <- Slope_FE_raw

R2_Check <- R2_Check_Raw %>% 
  dplyr::select(Curve, Plate, IDs, Conc_uM,  
                Abs1, Abs1_Removed, Abs2, Abs2_Removed,
                Abs1_Mean, Abs1_cv, 
                Abs2_Mean, Abs2_cv, 
                diff_Mean, diff_cv,
                R2, Slope, Intercept,
                Abs1_cv_flag, Abs2_cv_flag, R2_Flag) 

#calculate concentrations from standard curve and separate removable points
R2_Split <- R2_Check %>% mutate(
  RMVBL = case_when(Conc_uM %in% c(0, 0.6, 500)~"No", 
                    Conc_uM == 60 & Curve %like% "low"~ "No",
                    Conc_uM == 100 & !Curve %like% "low" & !Curve %like% "FE_2_high"~ "No",
                    .default = "Yes")) %>% 
  group_by(Plate, Curve) %>% dplyr::select(-Abs1, -Abs1_Removed, -Abs2, -Abs2_Removed) %>% distinct() %>% group_split()
#recalculate R2 with each std missing
R2_New <- map(
  R2_Split,
  ~ .x %>% mutate(
    R2_New_abs1 = map_dbl(row_number(), ~
                       summary(lm(Abs1_Mean[-.x] ~ Conc_uM[-.x], data = pick(Abs1_Mean, Conc_uM)))$adj.r.squared),
    R2_New_abs2 = map_dbl(row_number(), ~
                       summary(lm(Abs2_Mean[-.x] ~ Conc_uM[-.x], data = pick(Abs2_Mean, Conc_uM)))$adj.r.squared),
    R2_New_diff = map_dbl(row_number(), ~
                      summary(lm(diff_Mean[-.x] ~ Conc_uM[-.x], data = pick(diff_Mean, Conc_uM)))$adj.r.squared)
    )) %>% bind_rows()
#remove std furthest from STD curve or std with the highest CV
R2_Check_RMVBL <- R2_New %>%  group_by(Plate, Curve) %>% 
  mutate(R2_New = case_when(RMVBL %in% "No" ~ NA,
                    Curve == "FE_2_high"|Curve == "FE_2_low"|Curve == "FE_3_abs1" ~ R2_New_abs1,
                    Curve %like% "FE_Tot"|Curve == "FE_2_abs2" ~ R2_New_abs2,
                    Curve == "FE_2_diff" ~ R2_New_diff)) %>% 
  mutate(R2_RMV = ifelse(
    R2_Flag == "R2_Bad", ifelse(R2_New == max(R2_New, na.rm = TRUE), "RMVD", "KEPT"),
  "R2_Good")) %>% 
  mutate(R2_RMV_CV = ifelse(
    R2_RMV == "R2_Good",
      case_when(RMVBL %in% "No" ~ NA,
            Abs1_cv_flag == "High CV" & Abs1_cv == max(Abs1_cv) & (Curve == "FE_2_high"|Curve == "FE_2_low"|Curve == "FE_3_abs1") ~ "RMVD",
            Abs2_cv_flag == "High CV" & Abs2_cv == max(Abs2_cv) & (Curve %like% "FE_Tot"|Curve == "FE_2_abs2") ~ "RMVD", 
            diff_cv > cv_flag_stds & diff_cv == max(diff_cv) & Curve == "FE_2_diff" ~ "RMVD",
            .default = "KEPT"),
  R2_RMV
)) %>% mutate(R2_RMVD = ifelse(is.na(R2_RMV_CV), "KEPT", R2_RMV_CV)) %>% dplyr::select(-R2_RMV, -R2_RMV_CV)

#join back to full STD curves
R2_Removed_forPair <- R2_Check_RMVBL %>% dplyr::select(Plate, IDs, R2_RMVD) %>% distinct()

FE_STDs_Pair <- STDs_Curves %>% dplyr::select(Curve, Plate, IDs, Conc_uM, 
                                              Abs1, Abs1_Removed, Abs2, Abs2_Removed,
                                              Abs1_Mean, Abs1_cv, 
                                              Abs2_Mean, Abs2_cv, 
                                              Abs_diff, diff_Mean, diff_cv,
                                              Abs1_cv_flag, 
                                              Abs2_cv_flag) %>%
  left_join(R2_Removed_forPair)
#Change removed stds to NA
R2_Check_fin <- FE_STDs_Pair %>% mutate(STD_ABS1_rmv = ifelse(R2_RMVD == "RMVD", NA, Abs1),
                                        STD_ABS2_rmv = ifelse(R2_RMVD == "RMVD", NA, Abs2),
                                        STD_DIFF_rmv = ifelse(R2_RMVD == "RMVD", NA, Abs_diff)) %>% group_by(Plate,Curve) %>% 
  mutate(Points = ifelse("RMVD" %in% R2_RMVD, "Point_Removed", "ALL_KEPT")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Curve, Plate, IDs, Conc_uM, STD_ABS1_rmv, STD_ABS2_rmv, STD_DIFF_rmv, Abs1_cv_flag, Abs2_cv_flag, Points) %>% ungroup() %>% na.omit()

#separate plates for new regression
split_data_rmv <- R2_Check_fin %>%
  group_by(Plate,Curve) %>%
  group_split()

#get new standard curve values
Slope_FE_raw_list_rm <- map(split_data_rmv, ~ .x %>% mutate( 
  R2 =  case_when(
    Curve == "FE_2_diff"  ~ summary(lm(STD_DIFF_rmv ~ Conc_uM, data = .))$adj.r.squared,
    Curve == "FE_2_high"|Curve == "FE_2_low"|Curve == "FE_3_abs1"  ~ summary(lm(STD_ABS1_rmv ~ Conc_uM, data = .))$adj.r.squared,
    Curve %like% "FE_Tot"|Curve == "FE_2_abs2"  ~ summary(lm(STD_ABS2_rmv ~ Conc_uM, data = .))$adj.r.squared
  ), 
  Slope = case_when(
    Curve == "FE_2_diff"  ~ coef(lm(STD_DIFF_rmv ~ Conc_uM, data = .))[2],
    Curve == "FE_2_high"|Curve == "FE_2_low"|Curve == "FE_3_abs1"  ~ coef(lm(STD_ABS1_rmv ~ Conc_uM, data = .))[2],
    Curve %like% "FE_Tot"|Curve == "FE_2_abs2"  ~ coef(lm(STD_ABS2_rmv ~ Conc_uM, data = .))[2]
  ),
  Intercept = case_when(
    Curve == "FE_2_diff"  ~ coef(lm(STD_DIFF_rmv ~ Conc_uM, data = .))[1],
    Curve == "FE_2_high"|Curve == "FE_2_low"|Curve == "FE_3_abs1"  ~ coef(lm(STD_ABS1_rmv ~ Conc_uM, data = .))[1],
    Curve %like% "FE_Tot"|Curve == "FE_2_abs2"  ~ coef(lm(STD_ABS2_rmv ~ Conc_uM, data = .))[1]
  )))

Slope_FE_raw_rm <- bind_rows(Slope_FE_raw_list_rm)%>% mutate(Abs1 = STD_ABS1_rmv, Abs2 = STD_ABS2_rmv, Abs_diff = STD_DIFF_rmv)

Slope_FE_Std_Crvs_rm <- Slope_FE_raw_rm %>% dplyr::select(Plate, Curve, R2, Slope, Intercept, Points) %>% distinct() %>% mutate(R2_Flag = ifelse(R2 >= r2_cutoff, "R2_Good", "R2_Bad"))


```

#read in datafile with all the slopes

  mean_slope = mean(Slope, na.rm = TRUE),

### Slopes

## Method Minimum Detection Limit (MDL) Calculation
I use the lowest standard to calculate MDL
How to calculate MDL https://www.epa.gov/sites/default/files/2016-12/documents/mdl-procedure_rev2_12-13-2016.pdf
Look at Table 1 on page 5
The Student's t-value used to calculate the method detection limit (MDL) is the one appropriate for a 99% confidence level and a standard deviation estimate with n-1 degrees of freedom
```{r MDL, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
Fe2_std0 <- subset(FE_STD_CV_fin, Conc_uM == 0.0 , !Abs1_Removed == "RMVD" | !Abs2_Removed == "RMVD")
#get only lowest standard
 MDL_dat <- FE_STD_CV_fin %>% filter(IDs %like% "3 uM Fe[(]II[)]"
                                         , !Abs1_Removed == "RMVD" | !Abs2_Removed == "RMVD"
                                         )

#make a dataframe of just 0.6 uM Fe2 samples from standard dataframe
#MDL_dat <- subset(FE_2_stds_Abs1, Conc_uM == 0.6)

#calculate the standard deviation of abs 1
stddev <- sd(MDL_dat$Abs1)

#calculate n (number of 0.6 uM samples)
n <- nrow(MDL_dat)

#Identify the proper Student's T for n-1 from the table link above
StudentsT <-qt(.99,(n-1))

#Multiply Standard deviation by Student's T
MDL <- stddev*StudentsT
MDL

#add the MDL to the blank to find the lowest value detectible
BDL_Fe2 <- (MDL + mean(Fe2_std0$Abs1))
BDL_Fe3 <- (MDL + mean(Fe2_std0$Abs2))

MDL_Plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity', data = distinct(MDL_dat, Plate, IDs, Abs1_Mean), aes(x = Plate, y = Abs1_Mean, fill = IDs)) +
 # geom_bar(data = distinct(Fe2_std0, Plate, IDs, Abs1_Mean), aes(x = Plate, y = Abs1_Mean, fill = IDs), stat = 'identity') +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Standard:", values = c("0 uM Fe_2" = "lightgreen", "0 uM Fe_3" = "lightgreen","0.6 uM Fe_2 H" = "cornflowerblue")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept  = BDL_Fe2, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1.5, color = "blue3") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.25, y = MDL + 0.025, label = paste0("MDL: ",  MDL)) +
  ggtitle(label = "H2S Minimum Detection Limit") +
  labs(y = "Mean Absorbance") +
  theme_classic()

MDL_Plot


```

###Calculate concentrations of Fe(II)
Fe2_std60 <- subset(FE_2_stds_low, Conc_uM == 60.0)
Fe2_low <- subset(new_log_stds, Curve == "FE_2_low")
Fe2_high <- subset(new_log_stds, Curve == "FE_2_high")
stds_Fe2 <- stds %>%  mutate(
  FE_2_Conc_Abs1 = ifelse(
    Abs1 > mean(Fe2_std60$Abs1),
    (Abs1 - mean(Fe2_high$Intercept)) / mean(Fe2_high$Slope),
    (Abs1 - mean(Fe2_low$Intercept)) / mean(Fe2_low$Slope)
  ),
  FE_2_Conc_Abs2 = ifelse(
    Abs1 > mean(Fe2_std60$Abs1),
    (Abs2 - mean(Fe2_high$Intercept)) / mean(Fe2_high$Slope),
    (Abs2 - mean(Fe2_low$Intercept)) / mean(Fe2_low$Slope)
  )
) %>% group_by(Plate, IDs) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_Conc_Abs1 = mean(FE_2_Conc_Abs1),
    mean_Conc_Abs2 = mean(FE_2_Conc_Abs2),
    Abs1_std_chk = ((abs(mean_Conc_Abs1 - Conc_uM))/((mean_Conc_Abs1 + Conc_uM)/2)) *100,
    Chk_flag_Abs1 = ifelse(Abs1_std_chk > 10, "bad","Ok"),
    Abs2_std_chk = ((abs(mean_Conc_Abs2 - Conc_uM))/((mean_Conc_Abs2 + Conc_uM)/2)) *100,
    Chk_flag_Abs2 = ifelse(Abs2_std_chk > 10, "bad","Ok")
  )
